description: [$0.04] Trigger When: guarding a DeFi wallet against liquidation or stale approvals. Workflow Outcome: stress-tests Aave/Compound health factor (-10%/-20%) and builds unsigned repay & revoke txs. Do not use for pool yield discovery (use defi_yield_pools) or wallet PnL logs (use wallet_treasury_pnl). The `-10%` and `-20%` collateral drops are fixed stress simulations, while `target_health_factor` sets the safety target used to size `unsigned_aave_repay_tx`. Live Aave/Compound RPCs, read-only non-custodial (no broadcast); requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.
